caseName: Day v. Or. Comm'n on Judicial Fitness & Disability
caseNameFull: Vance D. DAY, Judge, Circuit Court of Oregon, Third Judicial District v. OREGON COMMISSION ON JUDICIAL FITNESS AND DISABILITY.

opinions.text: Motion of Freedom of Conscience Defense Fund for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Oregon denied.
